uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When facing nearby Berries or food, increases movement speed by 25%. Doubles the HP restored from eating Sitrus Berries. Restores an additional 1% max HP + 0 x (Lv. - 1) + 23 HP from eating Oran Berries (from Greedent Cheek Pouch). Alcremie's Recover heals 10% more HP than usual. Increases the effects gained from eating Berries.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, belly flopping forward to deal increased damage to opposing Pokémon and decrease their movement speed by 20% for 1s when it hits. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

The user readies a boosted attack and dashes belly first forward, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving the first opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. The boosted attack from this move remains readied until used. Charge forward belly first, dealing damage when it hits and shoving the first enemy it comes in contact with. After this move, the user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.

The user jumps up and slams down at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1s. Has the user slam its heavy body down, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throwing them.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

The user increases their movement speed by 80% for 3s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s over 2s; minimum 40% for 1s before this buff ends) and decreases the movement speed of nearby opposing Pokémon by 50% for 1.5s, and starts flailing about for 5s. While flailing about, auto attacks deal increased damage, with damage strengthening for every 20% max HP the user is missing. Basic attacks used while flailing about also decrease the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 20% for 1s; boosted attacks decrease movement speed by 50% for 1s. Has the user flail about, increasing the user's basic attack damage the lower the user's HP is.

Increases the damage dealt by auto attacks used while flailing about. When the user is below 40% max HP, auto attacks also restore the user's HP for 30% of damage dealt. Increased damage. If the user has low HP while using this move, its basic attacks that hit enemies will restore the user's HP.

The user becomes unstoppable and falls asleep on the spot for 3s, restoring 8% max HP every 1s over 3s (maximum 24% max HP). While using this move, opposing Pokémon cannot pass through Snorlax. This move cannot be used within an opposing Miraidon's Electric Terrain. Has the user fall asleep on the spot and restores its HP. Blocks the movement of all enemies while this move is in effect.

The user gains a shield for 3.5s; becomes unstoppable, decreases their movement speed by 30% and creates a wall with their arms spread wide in the designated direction for up to 4s. Opposing Pokémon cannot pass through the wall from behind, and those that contact the wall from the front are shoved and stunned for 0.45s; targets cannot be shoved more than once every 1s (maximum 4 times). The user can use this move again to drop the wall early, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and returning to normal movement speed. This move's cooldown begins when the wall ends. 17.4% max HP + 1560 Has the user spread its arms wide to create a wall and grants it a shield. Prevents enemies from passing through the wall and shoves them if they run into it.

Increases the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 35% while holding up the wall. Shoves opposing Pokémon contacting the wall from the front not more than once every 0.5s (maximum 8 times). Reduces the damage the user receives while this move is in effect.

The user lets out a huge yawn in the designated direction, putting opposing Pokémon in the area of effect to a deep sleep for up to 2.5s. Targets that are hit after their deep sleep is halfway through wake up immediately. Has the user let loose a huge yawn that lulls enemies into a sleepy haze, putting enemies hit by this move to sleep.
Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon waking up from a full deep sleep by 35% for 3s. Decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

The user becomes unstoppable and slams onto their back fast asleep, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1s; then continues to sleep for up to 4s afterward. The user starts snoring for the remainder of the Unite Move, restoring 10% max HP over time while fast asleep (up to 9 times; maximum 90%), damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect with a huge snore every 1.5s and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s when hit. This Unite Move can be used again before the user snores a second time to flip over in the designated sideways direction and slam the ground, dealing an extra instance of snore damage in the area of effect and throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. While the user is fast asleep, opposing Pokémon cannot pass through Snorlax. After the user flips over or snores a second time, the user can use this Unite Move again to stop sleeping early, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and returning to normal. Deals 50% of the initial damage, 3 times. Go to sleep and begin snoring, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. While sleeping, become immune to hindrances and continually restore HP.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Power Nap
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable and slams onto their back fast asleep, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1s; then continues to sleep for up to 4s afterward. The user starts snoring for the remainder of the Unite Move, restoring 10% max HP over time while fast asleep (up to 9 times; maximum 90%), damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect with a huge snore every 1.5s and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s when hit. This Unite Move can be used again before the user snores a second time to flip over in the designated sideways direction and slam the ground, dealing an extra instance of snore damage in the area of effect and throwing opposing Pokémon hit for 1s. While the user is fast asleep, opposing Pokémon cannot pass through Snorlax. After the user flips over or snores a second time, the user can use this Unite Move again to stop sleeping early, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and returning to normal. Deals 50% of the initial damage, 3 times. Go to sleep and begin snoring, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. While sleeping, become immune to hindrances and continually restore HP.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Power Nap は ねむりを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、妨害無効になる、妨害耐性を得る、HPを回復する、継続ダメージを与える、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
